# LinkSave (https://linksaves.com/)

> LinkSave is a fast, free, and secure online video downloader and audio converter. It allows users to download videos in HD 1080p, 4K, 720p MP4, and extract 320kbps MP3 audio from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, Pinterest, and LinkedIn with no registration or software installation required.

## Key Features
- **Universal Video Downloader**: High-speed MP4 downloads up to 4K / 1080p resolution across web platforms.
- **YouTube to MP3 Audio Converter**: Instant high-quality audio extraction (up to 320kbps) from video links.
- **TikTok Downloader**: Download TikTok videos without watermark in HD MP4 or MP3 audio.
- **Instagram Reels Downloader**: Save Instagram Reels, stories, and audio cleanly.
- **Cross-Platform Social Support**: Facebook, Pinterest Idea Pins, and LinkedIn video downloaders.
- **Universal Device Compatibility**: Works smoothly inside iOS Safari, Android Chrome, Windows, macOS, and Linux browsers.
- **Privacy First & Safe**: No account registration, zero conversion logs stored, and 100% free from malware.
